ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Getting Off to a Good Start

fullPassage:
High school is the best time to spark your curiosity and passion. You can explore, try new things, and learn more about yourself. The three years pass quickly, so use this time wisely to set yourself up for the future. Here are a few ways to do just that.
Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless benefits. You can have more new experiences and complete more challenging tasks with increased energy. The benefits are not limited to physical strength; exercise also boosts confidence and fosters a positive attitude. Whether you like lifting weights at the gym, jogging through the park, or riding a bicycle, establishing and sticking to an exercise routine will strengthen your body, mind, and spirit.
Choosing your career path is one of the most important decisions you can make, and having a role model can be a powerful tool for making your dreams come true. Looking into the lives of the people you admire can be an inspiration in itself. Your role model can be someone you know personally, such as a teacher or family member, or someone you admire, such as a famous athlete or artist. If you pick someone in your social circle, you can directly ask for their guidance. If it is someone you can't meet in person, you can study their actions and observe their strategies. What you learn from them will benefit you both during and long after high school.
These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy. To make it easier to focus on important things, set aside your devices for some time. For example, it's a good idea to finish surfing the Internet, watching videos, and sending instant messages during the week and turn everything off on the weekends. You can use your newly found time to connect with friends, family, and yourself. You might be surprised at how much more productive you can be when not glued to a screen.
Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. You could try sending a note to your future self. Writing a letter to your future self will allow you to take a moment to reflect on where you are, where you're heading, and what's important to you right now. Furthermore, when you're older, this letter can serve as a reminder of the person you used to be. It might even give you a new sense of strength to live a more meaningful life.
The high school years can be overwhelming at times, but the challenge is there for a reason, and you don't have to be perfect every step of the way. During your high school days, have a great time trying out different things and discovering what works best for you. More importantly, however, don't forget to have fun along the way!

questions.passage: High school is the best time to spark your curiosity and passion. You can explore, try new things, and learn more about yourself. The three years pass quickly, so use this time ①<u>wisely</u> to set yourself up for the future. Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not ②<u>easy</u>. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it ③<u>offers</u> countless benefits. Establishing and sticking to an exercise routine will ④<u>strengthening</u> your body, mind, and spirit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 운동 루틴을 만들고 고수하면 몸, 마음, 정신을 강화할 것이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①wisely: 부사로 동사 use 수식. ✅ ②easy: be동사 뒤 형용사 보어. ✅ ③offers: 주어 it(단수) 일치. ❌ ④strengthening: 조동사 will 뒤 동사원형 strengthen 필요.
det.tip: will + 동사원형. will strengthen (O) / will strengthening (X).

questions.passage: Choosing your career path is one of the most important decisions you can make, and having a role model can be a powerful tool for ①<u>making</u> your dreams come true. Looking into the lives of the people you ②<u>admire</u> can be an inspiration in itself. If you pick someone in your social circle, you can ③<u>direct</u> ask for their guidance. What you learn from them will ④<u>benefit</u> you both during and long after high school.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 사회적 인맥에서 누군가를 골라 직접 조언을 구할 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①making: 전치사 for 뒤 동명사. ✅ ②admire: 관계대명사절 동사. ✅ ④benefit: 조동사 will 뒤 동사원형. ❌ ③direct: 동사 ask를 수식하려면 부사 directly 필요.
det.tip: direct(형용사) vs directly(부사). 동사를 수식할 때는 부사 directly.

questions.passage: These days, many teenagers spend too much time ①<u>staring</u> at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late ②<u>playing</u> computer games. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy. You can use your newly found time to connect with friends, family, and yourself. You might be surprised at ③<u>how</u> much more productive you can be when not ④<u>gluing</u> to a screen.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 화면에 붙어있지(glued) 않으면 더 생산적일 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①staring: spend time + V-ing 정상. ✅ ②playing: stay up late + V-ing 정상. ✅ ③how: 간접의문문 정상. ❌ ④gluing: 수동 의미. '화면에 붙어있는' 상태이므로 glued(과거분사) 필요.
det.tip: glued to a screen: 화면에 '붙어있는' 수동 상태. gluing(능동) → glued(수동).

questions.passage: Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. Writing a letter to your future self will allow you ①<u>to take</u> a moment to reflect on ②<u>where</u> you are and where you're heading. Furthermore, when you're older, this letter can serve ③<u>as</u> a reminder of the person you used to be. It might even give you a new sense of strength ④<u>living</u> a more meaningful life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 더 의미 있는 삶을 살 힘을 줄 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①to take: allow + O + to V 정상. ✅ ②where: 간접의문문 접속부사. ✅ ③as: serve as ~ 정상. ❌ ④living: 'strength to live'에서 to부정사(형용사적 용법)가 필요. to live가 맞음.
det.tip: strength to live: ~할 힘. to부정사가 strength를 수식하는 형용사적 용법.

questions.passage: High school is the best time to spark your curiosity and passion. You can explore, try new things, and learn more about yourself. The three years pass quickly, so use this time wisely to set yourself up for the future. Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 규칙적 운동은 셀 수 없이 많은 이점을 제공한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③benefits(이점): 운동의 긍정적 효과. ❌ ①drawbacks(단점): 반대. ❌ ②hazards(위험): 부정적. ❌ ④penalties(벌칙): 무관.
det.tip: benefits: 이점, 혜택. 'offers countless benefits'는 '무수한 이점을 제공한다'.

questions.passage: Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. You could try sending a note to your future self. Writing a letter to your future self will allow you to take a moment to __________ on where you are, where you're heading, and what's important to you right now.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 미래의 자신에게 편지를 쓰면 현재 위치와 방향에 대해 돌아볼 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①reflect(돌아보다): 'reflect on'은 ~에 대해 성찰하다. ❌ ②depend(의존하다): 맥락 불일치. ❌ ③insist(주장하다): 무관. ❌ ④impose(부과하다): 무관.
det.tip: reflect on: ~에 대해 성찰하다, 돌아보다. 자기 자신을 돌아보는 맥락.

questions.passage: Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless benefits. You can have more new experiences and complete more challenging tasks with increased energy. The benefits are not limited to physical strength; exercise also boosts confidence and fosters a positive attitude.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"운동의 이점은 체력에만 국한된다."

det.korean: 운동의 이점은 체력에 국한되지 않는다. 자신감과 긍정적 태도도 길러준다.
det.analysis: ❌ F: 원문 'The benefits are not limited to physical strength'에서 체력에 '국한되지 않는다'고 명시. 자신감과 긍정적 태도도 포함.
det.tip: not limited to: ~에 국한되지 않는. 체력 외에 정신적 이점도 있다는 의미.

questions.passage: Choosing your career path is one of the most important decisions you can make, and having a role model can be a powerful tool for making your dreams come true. Looking into the lives of the people you admire can be an inspiration in itself. Your role model can be someone you know personally, such as a teacher or family member, or someone you admire, such as a famous athlete or artist.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"롤 모델은 반드시 개인적으로 아는 사람이어야 한다."

det.korean: 롤 모델은 개인적으로 아는 사람일 수도 있고, 유명한 운동선수나 예술가처럼 존경하는 사람일 수도 있다.
det.analysis: ❌ F: 원문에서 'someone you know personally' 또는 'a famous athlete or artist'라고 하여 반드시 아는 사람일 필요 없음.
det.tip: or: 롤 모델의 두 가지 유형을 제시. 개인적 아는 사람 OR 유명인.

questions.passage: These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy. To make it easier to focus on important things, set aside your devices for some time.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"기기가 삶을 풍요롭게 하는 한 사용해도 괜찮다."

det.korean: 기기가 삶을 풍요롭게 하는 한 괜찮다. 원문 'This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life'와 일치.
det.analysis: ✅ T: 원문 그대로. 조건부 허용: 삶을 풍요롭게 하는 한 괜찮다.
det.tip: as long as: ~하는 한. 조건절.

questions.passage: Choosing your career path is one of the most important decisions you can make, and having a role model can be a powerful tool for making your dreams come true. Looking into the lives of the people you admire can be an inspiration in itself. If you pick someone in your social circle, you can directly ask for their guidance. If it is someone you can't meet in person, you can study their actions and observe their __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 직접 만날 수 없는 사람이면 행동을 연구하고 전략을 관찰할 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②strategies(전략): 행동과 전략을 연구하는 맥락. ❌ ①weaknesses(약점): 롤 모델의 약점을 관찰하는 것은 부자연스러움. ❌ ③complaints(불만): 무관. ❌ ④excuses(변명): 무관.
det.tip: strategies: 전략, 방법. 롤 모델의 성공 전략을 관찰하여 배운다.

questions.passage: Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. The high school years can be overwhelming at times, but the challenge is there for a reason, and you don't have to be perfect every step of the way. During your high school days, have a great time trying out different things and discovering what works best for you. More importantly, however, don't forget to have fun __________!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 고등학교 시절은 힘들지만, 그 과정에서 즐기는 것을 잊지 마라.
det.analysis: ✅ ④along the way(그 과정에서): 여정 중에 즐기라는 메시지. ❌ ①in advance(미리): 맥락 불일치. ❌ ②by accident(우연히): 무관. ❌ ③at random(무작위로): 무관.
det.tip: along the way: 도중에, 그 과정에서. 인생의 여정에서 즐기라는 조언.

questions.passage: These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy. To make it easier to focus on important things, set aside your devices for some time. For example, it's a good idea to finish surfing the Internet, watching videos, and sending instant messages during the week and turn everything off on the weekends.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 요즘 청소년들은 스마트폰 사용 시간이 줄고 있다.
기술에 대한 과도한 의존이 체력을 강화시킨다.
주말에 모든 기기를 끄는 것이 좋은 방법이다.
인터넷 서핑은 주말에만 하는 것이 좋다.

det.korean: 주중에 인터넷 서핑을 끝내고 주말에 모든 것을 끄는 것이 좋은 생각이라고 했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③: 원문 'turn everything off on the weekends'와 일치. ❌ ①: 사용 시간이 '줄고 있다'는 언급 없음(오히려 너무 많이 사용). ❌ ②: 체력이 아닌 mental energy를 고갈시킴. ❌ ④: 주중에 끝내라고 했지 주말에만 하라는 말 아님.
det.tip: during the week(주중에) vs on the weekends(주말에). 주중에 마치고 주말에 끄기.

questions.passage: Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. You could try sending a note to your future self. Writing a letter to your future self will allow you to take a moment to reflect on where you are, where you're heading, and what's important to you right now. Furthermore, when you're older, this letter can serve as a reminder of the person you used to be. It might even give you a new sense of strength to live a more meaningful life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 현재의 관심사와 관점은 시간이 지나면 사라질 수 있다.
미래의 자신에게 편지를 쓰면 현재의 관심사가 영원히 유지된다.
편지는 과거의 자신을 상기시키는 역할을 한다.
편지가 더 의미 있는 삶을 살 힘을 줄 수 있다.

det.korean: 원문은 관심사가 '사라질 수 있다(may fade)'고 했지, 편지를 쓰면 영원히 유지된다고는 말하지 않았다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②불일치: 편지는 성찰과 상기의 도구이지, 관심사를 영원히 유지시키는 것이 아님. ❌ ①: 원문 'may fade'와 일치. ❌ ③: 'serve as a reminder'와 일치. ❌ ④: 'give you a new sense of strength'와 일치.
det.tip: may fade: 사라질 수 있다. 편지는 기억의 도구이지 영속화의 수단이 아님.

questions.passage: Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless benefits. ①You can have more new experiences and complete more challenging tasks with increased energy. ②The benefits are limited to physical strength. ③Exercise also boosts confidence and fosters a positive attitude. ④Establishing and sticking to an exercise routine will strengthen your body, mind, and spirit.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 원문과 다른 부분이 포함된 문장은?

det.korean: 원문은 'The benefits are not limited to physical strength'인데 ②에서 not이 빠져 의미가 반대가 되었다.
det.analysis: ❌ ②: 'not limited' → 'limited'로 변경. 원문은 체력에 국한되지 '않는다'이지만, ②는 '국한된다'로 변조.
det.tip: not limited to: ~에 국한되지 않는. not의 유무가 의미를 완전히 바꿈.

questions.passage: High school is the best time to __________ your curiosity and passion. You can explore, try new things, and learn more about yourself. The three years pass quickly, so use this time wisely to set yourself up for the future.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 영어 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.

(힌트: '불을 붙이다, 촉발하다'라는 뜻의 동사)

det.korean: 호기심과 열정에 불을 붙이다(spark).
det.analysis: spark: 불꽃을 일으키다 → 비유적으로 '촉발하다, 자극하다'. 빈칸에 spark를 넣으면 원문 완성.
det.tip: spark: 점화하다, 자극하다. 'spark curiosity'는 '호기심을 촉발하다'.

questions.passage: Choosing your career path is one of the most important decisions you can make, and having a role model can be a [power] tool for making your dreams come true.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: 롤 모델은 꿈을 이루기 위한 강력한(powerful) 도구가 될 수 있다.
det.analysis: power → powerful. 명사 tool을 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 powerful.
det.tip: power(명사: 힘) → powerful(형용사: 강력한). 명사 앞 수식어 = 형용사.

questions.passage: These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy. To make it easier to focus on important things, set aside your devices for some time. For example, it's a good idea to finish surfing the Internet, watching videos, and sending instant messages during the week and turn everything off on the weekends. You can use your newly found time to connect with friends, family, and yourself. __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. be / more / you / productive / can / how / surprised / at / much / might / be / You
questions.wa: You might be surprised at how much more productive you can be
accept: YOU MIGHT BE SURPRISED AT HOW MUCH MORE PRODUCTIVE YOU CAN BE
You might be surprised at how much more productive you can be
You might be surprised at how much more productive you can be.

det.korean: 화면에 붙어있지 않으면 얼마나 더 생산적일 수 있는지 놀랄 것이다.
det.analysis: 어순: You might be surprised at how much more productive you can be. 'be surprised at' + 간접의문문(how much more productive).
det.tip: be surprised at: ~에 놀라다. how much more productive: 얼마나 더 생산적인지.

questions.passage: Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless benefits. You can have more new experiences and complete more challenging tasks with increased energy. The benefits are not limited to physical strength; exercise also boosts confidence and fosters a positive attitude. Whether you like lifting weights at the gym, jogging through the park, or riding a bicycle, establishing and sticking to an exercise routine will strengthen your body, mind, and spirit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 운동이 체력뿐 아니라 자신감과 태도에도 도움이 된다는 규칙적 운동의 이점이 주제.
det.analysis: ✅ ①: 본문 전체가 운동의 다양한 이점(체력, 자신감, 태도)을 설명. ❌ ②: 시간 관리는 서두에만 언급. ❌ ③: 신체적 힘에만 '국한되지 않는다'고 명시. ❌ ④: 자전거는 예시 중 하나.
det.tip: 주제 = 글 전체를 아우르는 핵심 내용. 부분적 언급이나 예시는 주제가 아님.

questions.passage: These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy.
